briefing.headline: xAI and OpenAI accelerate multi-agent deployments amid escalating compute race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push larger models with integrated tool use while governments signal new oversight. Funding remains robust as infrastructure buildout accelerates globally. AI security gaps widen in production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: xAI released Grok-3 with 2T parameters; OpenAI testing Orion internally. Anthropic ships Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 claims efficiency gains. Meta open-sources Llama-4 variants. Multi-agent orchestration emerges as key differentiator.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, IoT and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell clusters to Microsoft and Google; TSMC ramps 2nm capacity. Saudi Arabia announces $40B AI data center project. Energy constraints slow European rollouts.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight frontier models close the capability gap with closed labs by end of 2027?
